### 🚀 About Me

I bridge the gap between **data engineering** and **data analytics**.

- 🔭 **Currently:** building raw → staging → reporting pipelines with **dbt on Snowflake & Databricks**, powering **Tableau** and **Looker** dashboards for stakeholder reporting
- 🤖 **Applied AI:** LLM-assisted development (Claude API, Cursor), prompt engineering, and **multi-agent workflow automation** — including a custom **Visual Story Teller** agent — for pipeline planning, docs, code review, and data storytelling
- ⚙️ **Automation & CI/CD:** designing pipelines with **n8n**, **GitHub Actions**, and **GitLab CI** — releases shipped through peer-reviewed PRs
- 🏭 **ERP background:** implemented **Infor LN CloudSuite** across Order-to-Cash, Purchase-to-Pay, Quality, and Warehouse — including data-intensive parts management for industrial manufacturing clients
- 📊 **Finance lens:** Senior Equity Analyst mindset — fundamental analysis, custom technical indicators, and non-speculative growth theses
- 🎵 **Beyond tech:** I produce **Italian Phonk** and electronic music with **Ableton** and **Suno AI**
